agent_descriptions.current_form_analyst: Recent results, momentum, and scoring/conceding trends — whether a side is rising or sliding right now. Reads fixtures and form from the shared evidence store.
agent_descriptions.tactical_performance_analyst: On-pitch performance end to end: attacking output and chance creation (in possession), defensive solidity and goalkeeping (out of possession), and counter-attack/counter-press (transitions). Merger of the in/out/transition analysts.
agent_descriptions.context_sentiment_analyst: The human and contextual side: fatigue/injury risk and fixture congestion (physical), mentality and discipline under pressure (psychological), narrative and hype (social), and the fan voice itself. Merger of the physical/psychological/social/fan-sentiment analysts.
